payload.title: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-004: Extract and resolve entities and relations with caps, chunked POST, and postAnalysisBodySchema validation
payload.body:
**Ticket ID:** `MP-ART-ANALYSIS-004`  
**Priority:** P0  

---


# Extract and resolve entities and relations with caps, chunked POST, and postAnalysisBodySchema validation

**Group:** Article Analysis Agent (`article-analysis-agent`)

## Summary

Implements Phase B and C of the analysis pipeline: structured extraction from article text using allowed `entityTypes` and `relationTypes`, normalization and deduplication against `existingEntities` and aliases, enforcement of configurable caps, and persistence via POST in bounded chunks with validation against `postAnalysisBodySchema` before each request.

## Scope

- In scope: LLM or hybrid extraction producing proposed entities (`canonicalName`, `typeId`, optional `description`, `aliases`) and relations (`fromEntityName`, `toEntityName`, `relationTypeId`) using only type IDs present in GET response (FR3). Name normalization (trim, consistent casing for matching). Optional truncation or summarization when content exceeds token budget (config-driven, full text remains in DB). Split POST bodies into sequential chunks per ticker per FR9 (configurable chunk size, default range 10 to 50 articles worth of writes as applicable to entity and relation batches). Validate each chunk with `postAnalysisBodySchema` before POST. Enforce max new entities and max relations per article and per run from Hermes config (wired in MP-ART-ANALYSIS-009 or placeholder constants until then).
- Out of scope: `articleEntities` and `articleRelevances` arrays in the same POST beyond empty or minimal stubs if API requires non-empty union handling (prefer sequencing with MP-ART-ANALYSIS-005 if contract allows partial posts, or include empty arrays only).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Extracted type IDs and relation type IDs are always subsets of GET vocabulary or the run fails that slice with a structured error.
- [ ] Proposed names resolve to existing entities or aliases before creating duplicates (FR3 resolution rules).
- [x] Each POST chunk passes schema validation (for example `postAnalysisBodySchema.safeParse`) before sending, invalid items are not persisted (FR6).
- [ ] Chunk size and sequential per-ticker posting comply with FR9, no unbounded single POST for large batches.
- [ ] Caps on entities and relations per article and per run are enforced before POST.
- [ ] Response counts from POST (`entitiesCreated`, `entitiesReused`, `relationsCreated`) are logged or surfaced for observability.
- [ ] Unit tests cover resolution, cap enforcement, chunk splitting, and validation failure paths.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-003
- Blocks: MP-ART-ANALYSIS-005

## Notes

Logical phases B through C may share one LLM call with later phases in a later optimization, but writes must remain chunked per FR9. Secrets and raw article content must not appear in debug logs (Security section of PRD).

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/article-analysis-agent-prd.md
